newsitem.title: SWEDEN: NCC sets range for NK unit 55-64 SKR/share.
newsitem.headline: NCC sets range for NK unit 55-64 SKR/share.

text.p: Swedish construction and real estate company NCC on Tuesday set a price range of 55-64 crowns a share for spinning off a city property unit, NK Cityfastigheter AB.
NK Cityfastigheter, which consists of NK department stores and other city shopping properties, has properties to a book value of about 2.2 billion crowns.
NCC said the prospectus would be released on March 3 with the bid period ending on March 13.
The final sale price will be announced on March 14.
NK CItyfastigheter will be listed on the Stockholm bourse's O-list on March 21.
NCC said it would sell 60-75 percent of shares in the unit which has about 19.46 million shares.

"The public listing of NK Cityfastigheter AB is part of our strategy of reducing and concentrating NCC's real estate portfolio and realising hidden value," said company president Jan Sjoqvist in a statement.
"We will continue to hold a substantial interest in the company."
If it is assumed if NCC sells 67.5 percent of shares at a price of 59.50 crowns, it will generate a capital gain of about 100 million crowns.
